title: Discord 3/25 語音崩盤覆盤——一行誤設掀翻 voice control plane
summary: 重播 3/25/26 Discord 語音中斷三小時：pod 終結引爆 gateway OOM、syncer mailbox 膨脹、etcd hash-ring ejection——以及 on-call 在哪一刻認清「rollback 不是解」。
widget_questions: At each stage of the 3/25 cascade, what state mutates in Discord's voice control plane — from pod termination through DOWN-storm, gateway OOM, mailbox blowup, to etcd hash-ring ejection?
Why did the first three mitigation attempts (single-instance restart, supervisor kill, full cluster restart) fail while the fourth (upstream rate limits plus doubled dispatcher capacity) succeeded?
What structural change replaced the single contended Holster.Pool supervisor, and why does sharding the mailbox into N partitions defuse the O(n) selective receive degradation?
How was the ~1M-message mailbox blowup distributed across the 15 syncer instances — was it concentrated in a few, or did the whole fleet move together?
